avis.texte: The serum works as well as products twice their price, maybe even better! The silky texture goes on so smooth and is absorbed completely without being sticky. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate it and the scent is very calming. I love this serum!

Liked this serum more than I thought I would. Immediately noticed how soft my skin was when it's normally so rough in the winter. Time will tell the other long term benefits. Would be interested in these same ingredients in a face cream too.
This product has made me love my skin again I can't say enough good things about it.

avis.titre: Always come back to this serum
avis.texte: This serum always fixes my skin whenever I start using it again. I have dry skin that can be somewhat sensitive and it has never given me a reaction. Ive been using this for 2 years. It hydrates my skin and makes my face look more alive. My favorite skincare product

This product brought my results than I expected. Been using for a month at this point and it really does seem to lift the skin and reduce wrinkles. I saw this being talked about on tiktok and I'm so glad I gave it a try. I have never had such results.
Just purchased this mad hippee products..4 of them..they are fantastic..I am 71..and they actually work..makes me happy..and will definitely buy the rest..I want them all
I've been using for a few months and my skin looks so lifted! I didn't think the peptides would have such an effect but wow!
This product has so many good peptides in it. I've noticed the skin on my neck and face to be more firm and my skin just overall looks better.

I have been using the Mad Hippie Corrective Peptide Serum day and night and I am honestly blown away by the results. From the first application my skin felt instantly refreshed and hydrated. The serum is incredibly lightweight, absorbs quickly, and has a clean, fresh scent that is both subtle and uplifting. Over time I have noticed a real transformation. My skin feels significantly softer, my fine lines have visibly diminished, and dark spots are definitely fading. My pores have certainly gotten smaller too. It has become a go-to in my routine for prepping my face before makeup or simply wearing it as a protective, nourishing layer throughout the day. Even after a full day my skin still feels supple and hydrated. This serum truly lives up to its name. Corrective, rejuvenating, and a total must-have for anyone looking to boost their skincare results naturally. I highly recommend it. And you can reuse the bottle after!
Umm‚ where to begin. This product has made wrinkles smoother and my skin feel tighter. And it's super hydrating. It's a winner.

This product has done more for my skin than any other skincare product I've tried. It's super hydrating and my skin seems to have a lift after using it for a month. I'm now on my second bottle and I don't see myself ever not using this serum! I would recommend it to anyone and everyone.

Been using this for about 3 to 4 months now and i'm really impressed by how the product has maintained my skin without any breakouts. I tend to be sensitive to serums like this and it didn't do anything to me. I'm 29 and I just noticed some of the under eye smile lines (some from dryness but I wanted to be careful) and these have reduced them by at least 70%. Smells literally amazing‚ like an actual flower. Consistent application and I think it's a fair amount in the bottle for the price. Will never get rid of this!
Love them ALL, this serum though is my favorite serum they got, improves my wrinkles. All their products improved my skin tremendously highly recommend!

I rarely write reviews, but I just remembered that I had a sample of the corrective peptide serum that I had yet to try‚ after I washed with some vit c cleanser I had, and followed with a glycolic toner - I patted on the serum sample and felt like within minutes my skin started feeling tighter. It feels smoother and I swear I think it looks better in ONE USE!
Umm...this product is wild! I didn't know if I should believe the hype and the clinicals are crazy. All I can say is TRY IT

I really like this serum, along with a couple of other MH products. However, something is off. I've gone through a few bottles all the while noticing occasional flakes of stuff on my face. I finally figured it out- it's this serum. What's weird is that I'll find a few flakes on my face immediately- not later on in the day. Clearly something isn't mixed well/dissolved, or something. I think this is what some reviewers are calling glitter. I store my product in the fridge, in a box. It's not like I could've caused it to go bad and do this. It really makes me question the quality of the ingredients and/or manufacturing. Otherwise, I like it. But I'm going to stop buying.

I immediately saw results when I used this. I'm talking a two day turnaround. I have a wrinkle between my eyebrows near the bridge of my nose, laugh lines and dark circles around my eyes. I tried everything and this is the only product that worked. I didn't expect it to take care of my circles but it definitely lightened them. I have to continue using it because it works! If you're on the fence, take the chance. You won't be disappointed!

Honestly wasn't expecting to like this or any of my products this much. Clean ingredients and they work! My skin looks and feels smooth and moisturized. Rosacea friendly and honestly has helped reduce my redness! I'm not surprised it's sold out...it's that good
I have been using these products since pandemic, what a change, my fav is peptide serum, I use them all. I'm 65 told I look 45, I'll take it!

avis.titre: I think I've found the Holy Grail of Skincare
avis.texte: I rarely write reviews of sjincare products. But todsy is Saturday, and my order of Mad Hippie Corrective Peptide Seeum was delivered Wednesday. I followed the instructions on the Mad Hippie website for use, so I've been applying for three nights now over the Mad Hippie Supwr A Serum. This is making a huge difference in my skin firmness. For the last year or two (I'll be 57 years old in two months), I've noticed significant sagging along my jawline, near my chin. I've tried everything that surgery to get rid of these jowls, including very expensive products from my local dermatologist's cosmetic portion of the practice and some IPL treatment. In three uses, the corrective peptide serum has done more than anything else I've tried. I will be a dedicated user of Mad Hippie products from now on. I also use the Vitamin C serum in the morning. My skin can be sensitive, but I am having nothing. But good results with these products. Thank you, Mad Hippie, and thank you, Ulta, for carrying the products and making them easy to obtain.

I bought my first MadHippie product yesterday. I bought the Microdermabrasion. I love it. Just as advertised, texture of skin was very smooth, looked better overall, not too harsh. I've heard it really helps with tightening. I want to try the whole line one product at a time, as I use my present ones up. Thanks for answering.

I'm 44 and I've been using this for about 6 months and and I can feel and see and instant lift around my mouth and cheeks where my skin is sagging some. I apply it and use the night cream over it. The next day I can still see a difference. Amazing!

I'm 44 and I've been using this for about 6 months and and I can feel and see and instant lift around my mouth and cheeks where my skin is sagging some. I apply it and use the night cream over it. The next day I can still see a difference. Amazing!

avis.titre: Visible difference in expression lines literally overnight

These are accentuated if I'm at all dehydrated, or if the hyaluronic acid I use as an addition to my Mad Hippie products isn't plumping things up as well as I'd like. This serum will be an important addition to my skincare regimen.

Mad hippie is such an underrated brand.

My new skin care favorite. I'm a huge fan of peptide serums and saw mad hippie had one and absolutely had to try it. My skin is hydrated, and feeling smoother than ever. Honestly I haven't been using much else anymore, this kind of takes the cake.
